focus: 連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能~Connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance

units.anchor: 剩餘厚度判讀~Remaining thickness interpretation
units.title: 剩餘厚度判讀~Remaining thickness interpretation
units.mechanism: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。厚度比例只是幾何指標，承載還取決於材料、缺陷、橢圓度及原管支承狀態。假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。~CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. Thickness ratio is a geometric indicator, while capacity also depends on material properties, defects, ovality and host-pipe support. An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness.
units.verify: 按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。同時排除以下干擾原因：若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。~Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.
units.failure: 若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。~Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.
units.misconception: 只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接剩餘厚度判讀時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。~When handing over remaining thickness interpretation, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone.

units.anchor: 理想薄環屈曲~Ideal thin ring buckling
units.title: 理想薄環屈曲~Ideal thin ring buckling
units.mechanism: 外水壓可使內襯向內屈曲，薄環模型展示厚徑比的立方敏感度。此模型是均勻圓環且無側向拘束的理想彈性上限尺度，實際設計須另考慮長期模數、橢圓及土體互制。假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。~External water pressure can buckle a liner inward. The thin-ring model illustrates cubic sensitivity to thickness ratio for an ideal uniform circular elastic ring without lateral restraint; real design additionally requires long-term modulus, ovality and soil interaction. For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure. Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure.
units.verify: 量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。同時排除以下干擾原因：初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。~Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure.
units.failure: 初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。~Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure.
units.misconception: 只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接理想薄環屈曲時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。~When handing over ideal thin ring buckling, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design.

units.anchor: 內壓環向應力~Internal pressure hoop stress
units.title: 內壓環向應力~Internal pressure hoop stress
units.mechanism: 受壓供水管內襯與重力污水管的荷載情境不同，不能共用同一個簡化合格判定。薄壁環向拉應力假設內襯獨立承壓，端部、接管與水錘應另列局部及瞬態需求。取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。~A pressurized water-main liner and a gravity-sewer liner face different load cases. Thin-wall hoop stress assumes independent internal-pressure resistance; ends, laterals and water hammer create additional local and transient demands. For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress. A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress.
units.verify: 比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。試驗壓力、隔離及排氣由責任工程師制定，本算例不構成現場加壓程序。同時排除以下干擾原因：只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。~Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. The responsible engineer sets pressure, isolation and venting procedures; this example does not authorize field pressurization. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces.

Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. The responsible engineer sets pressure, isolation and venting procedures; this example does not authorize field pressurization.

units.anchor: 厚度立方敏感度~Cubic thickness sensitivity
units.title: 厚度立方敏感度~Cubic thickness sensitivity
units.mechanism: 內襯彎曲剛度對厚度高度敏感，局部變薄的影響可能遠大於其面積比例。比較同材料與相同幾何的厚度變動才能隔離此效應，不能混入模數及直徑的變化。同材料其他條件固定時，厚度由6mm降為5mm，彎曲剛度比Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579，即約保留57.9%；D在此指板彎曲剛度。把厚度減少六分之一誤當剛度也只減少六分之一，會低估薄帶效應；薄帶若和橢圓長軸或皺褶重合，局部變形可能先主導整段失效。~Liner bending stiffness is highly sensitive to thickness, making local thinning more important than its area fraction suggests. Compare the same material and geometry to isolate this effect rather than mixing changes in modulus or diameter. With material and other conditions fixed, reducing thickness from6mm to5mm gives bending-stiffness ratio Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579, or57.9% retention. Here D denotes plate flexural rigidity. Assuming a one-sixth thickness reduction causes only one-sixth stiffness loss understates the effect. A thin band coinciding with ovality or wrinkling can control local deformation and segment failure.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：同材料其他條件固定時，厚度由6mm降為5mm，彎曲剛度比Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579，即約保留57.9%；D在此指板彎曲剛度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With material and other conditions fixed, reducing thickness from6mm to5mm gives bending-stiffness ratio Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579, or57.9% retention. Here D denotes plate flexural rigidity.
units.verify: 依厚度圖辨識連續薄帶，再將其位置與外壓、缺陷及支承狀態疊合。採代表性試片取得模數，並把局部剛度差納入分析而非只檢查平均材料值。同時排除以下干擾原因：把厚度減少六分之一誤當剛度也只減少六分之一，會低估薄帶效應；薄帶若和橢圓長軸或皺褶重合，局部變形可能先主導整段失效。~Identify continuous thin bands on the thickness map and relate them to pressure, defects and support. Obtain modulus from representative samples and include local stiffness differences rather than checking average material values alone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Assuming a one-sixth thickness reduction causes only one-sixth stiffness loss understates the effect. A thin band coinciding with ovality or wrinkling can control local deformation and segment failure.

units.anchor: 固化反應證據~Evidence of cure reaction
units.title: 固化反應證據~Evidence of cure reaction
units.mechanism: 固化不是只看表面硬化，樹脂反應可能因溫度分布、時間與材料混合而不同。熱分析估計反應進度是一種材料證據，仍需結合力學試驗與整段製程紀錄。假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。~Cure cannot be inferred solely from a hard surface. Temperature distribution, duration and mixing affect resin reaction. Thermal analysis provides one measure of reaction progress, which must be combined with mechanical tests and full-process records. For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures. A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures.
units.verify: 比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。固化驗收依材料供應與設計核准規格，不採通用百分比。同時排除以下干擾原因：薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。~Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. Review flexural modulus and glass-transition behaviour as well; cure acceptance follows approved material and design specifications, not a universal percentage. Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. Review flexural modulus and glass-transition behaviour as well; cure acceptance follows approved material and design specifications, not a universal percentage.

units.anchor: 長期模數折減~Long term modulus reduction
units.title: 長期模數折減~Long term modulus reduction
units.mechanism: 聚合物內襯在持續荷載下產生蠕變，短期模數不能無條件延用到長期屈曲評估。折減值受樹脂、溫度、環境及試驗時間控制，須有相符的材料證據。假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。~Polymeric liners creep under sustained load, so short-term modulus cannot automatically represent long-term buckling behaviour. Reduction depends on resin, temperature, environment and duration, requiring evidence applicable to the installed material. If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners. Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners.
units.verify: 檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。同時排除以下干擾原因：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。~Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.

A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.
units.misconception: 只要長期模數折減符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for long term modulus reduction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接長期模數折減時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。~When handing over long term modulus reduction, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range.

units.anchor: 水理容量比較~Hydraulic capacity comparison
units.title: 水理容量比較~Hydraulic capacity comparison
units.mechanism: 內襯使管徑縮小但可改善粗糙度，兩種效應必須同時計入。滿流圓管的曼寧比值只適用坡度相同且均勻流，局部瓶頸、支管及淤積會使實際系統不同。固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。~Lining reduces diameter while potentially improving roughness, so both effects matter. A full circular-pipe Manning ratio assumes equal slope and uniform flow; bottlenecks, laterals and deposits can make system behaviour different. For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35. Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35.
units.verify: 比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。不能把理想容量增加直接宣稱為暴雨排水保證，還需檢查下游控制及入流。同時排除以下干擾原因：粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。~Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels. An ideal capacity increase is not a storm-drainage guarantee; downstream controls and inflow also require review. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.
units.failure: 粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。~Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.
units.misconception: 只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接水理容量比較時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。不能把理想容量增加直接宣稱為暴雨排水保證，還需檢查下游控制及入流。~When handing over hydraulic capacity comparison, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels. An ideal capacity increase is not a storm-drainage guarantee; downstream controls and inflow also require review.

units.anchor: 支管開口幾何~Lateral opening geometry
units.title: 支管開口幾何~Lateral opening geometry
units.mechanism: 重新開通支管必須辨識真實接入口，切除內襯的範圍同時關係水流、密封與剩餘結構。面積只是幾何量，接頭邊緣缺口及未密封環隙仍需獨立檢核。假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。~Restoring laterals requires identifying the actual connection. Removing liner affects flow, sealing and remaining structure. Area is only a geometric quantity; edge notches and an unsealed annular gap require independent evaluation. For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m². This is neither a cutting instruction nor a guaranteed minimum flow area. A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m². This is neither a cutting instruction nor a guaranteed minimum flow area.
units.verify: 對照施工前支管位置與施工後影像，記錄每個接頭的邊緣、密封及可見缺陷。任何開口修整由合格施工與檢驗人員按核准方法執行，避免依影像猜測盲切。同時排除以下干擾原因：錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。~Reconcile prelining connection locations with postlining images, recording edges, seals and defects for every lateral. Qualified personnel follow approved restoration and inspection methods rather than blindly cutting from an uncertain image. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal.
units.failure: 錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。~A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal.
units.misconception: 只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接支管開口幾何時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照施工前支管位置與施工後影像，記錄每個接頭的邊緣、密封及可見缺陷。任何開口修整由合格施工與檢驗人員按核准方法執行，避免依影像猜測盲切。~When handing over lateral opening geometry, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile prelining connection locations with postlining images, recording edges, seals and defects for every lateral. Qualified personnel follow approved restoration and inspection methods rather than blindly cutting from an uncertain image.

units.anchor: 旁通儲量需求~Bypass storage demand
units.title: 旁通儲量需求~Bypass storage demand
units.mechanism: 施工期間旁通系統需要面對持續入流與設備中斷，儲量與抽送能力不能互相替代。簡單累積量適合辨識停機後果，實際應變仍受尖峰流量、上游容積及允許水位控制。假設入流Q=0.02m³/s、停機t=1800s且無出流，V=Qt=36m³；此為累積需求，不能直接推成安全撤離時間或容許停機時間。將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。~Temporary bypassing must handle continuing inflow and equipment interruptions. Storage and pumping capacity are not interchangeable. A simple accumulation estimate illustrates outage consequences, while peak flow, upstream volume and permitted levels govern the response plan. For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³. This is accumulated demand, not an allowable shutdown or evacuation time. Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設入流Q=0.02m³/s、停機t=1800s且無出流，V=Qt=36m³；此為累積需求，不能直接推成安全撤離時間或容許停機時間。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³. This is accumulated demand, not an allowable shutdown or evacuation time.
units.verify: 由歷史與當期流量建立尖峰情境，核對可用儲量、備援、警報與回應程序。任何切換或隔離須依業主核准方案，並確認排放路徑與周邊環境限制。同時排除以下干擾原因：將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。~Use historical and current flow to define peak scenarios, checking usable storage, backup, alarms and response procedures. Switching or isolation follows the owner's approved plan with verified discharge routes and environmental constraints. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption.
units.failure: 將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。~Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption.
units.misconception: 只要旁通儲量需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for bypass storage demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接旁通儲量需求時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。由歷史與當期流量建立尖峰情境，核對可用儲量、備援、警報與回應程序。任何切換或隔離須依業主核准方案，並確認排放路徑與周邊環境限制。~When handing over bypass storage demand, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Use historical and current flow to define peak scenarios, checking usable storage, backup, alarms and response procedures. Switching or isolation follows the owner's approved plan with verified discharge routes and environmental constraints.

units.anchor: 材料批次可追溯性~Material batch traceability
units.title: 材料批次可追溯性~Material batch traceability
units.mechanism: 內襯交接應連結樹脂批次、施工記錄、取樣位置與試驗結果，讓後續缺陷能回溯到特定區段。可追溯比例只是文件完整性，不能代替材料與水理驗收。假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。~Handover links resin batches, process records, sample positions and test results so later defects can be traced to a specific segment. A traceability fraction measures documentation completeness, not material or hydraulic acceptance. If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. The remaining section stays unresolved; the overall percentage cannot waive its acceptance requirements. Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. The remaining section stays unresolved; the overall percentage cannot waive its acceptance requirements.
units.verify: 隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。同時排除以下干擾原因：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。~Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs.
units.failure: 如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。~Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs.
units.misconception: 只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接材料批次可追溯性時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。~When handing over material batch traceability, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification.

title: 管道原位固化內襯~Cured-in-place pipe lining
summary: 本課聚焦連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。~This course focuses on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
example: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。假設厚度由6mm增為6.6mm而參照厚度固定10mm，幾何保留比例由60%增為66%，增加6個百分點；同材料彎曲剛度比為1.1³=1.331，但不能直接宣稱承載力增加33.1%。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。~The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Increasing assumed thickness from6mm to6.6mm against a fixed10mm reference raises retention from60% to66%, or6 percentage points. Same-material flexural rigidity changes by1.1³=1.331, but this does not directly establish33.1% more capacity. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
history: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能的背景。美國環保署出版污水收集系統復健技術報告（2010）。美國環保署出版丹佛與哥倫布內襯回溯研究（2011）。美國環保署出版克里夫蘭供水管示範評估（2012）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。~This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance. US EPA publishes its wastewater rehabilitation technology report (2010). US EPA publishes the Denver and Columbus retrospective liner study (2011). US EPA publishes the Cleveland water-main demonstration evaluation (2012). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure.

教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress.

教學假設，非現場設定值：同材料其他條件固定時，厚度由6mm降為5mm，彎曲剛度比Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579，即約保留57.9%；D在此指板彎曲剛度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With material and other conditions fixed, reducing thickness from6mm to5mm gives bending-stiffness ratio Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579, or57.9% retention. Here D denotes plate flexural rigidity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners.

sources.title: 市政污水管內襯回溯評估

sources.scope: 二〇一一年丹佛與哥倫布試體研究；有限樣本不代表所有內襯的壽命或規格。
sources.scopeEn: 2011 study of Denver and Columbus specimens; limited samples do not establish universal liner life or specifications.

sources.scopeEn: 2012 evaluation of a specific water-main product, used to contrast evidence for pressure and gravity pipes.
